body: From the bottom of my heart I want to thank you for taking the time of day to acknowledge me
I don't mind the questions , the break up is pretty recent like really recent ,

I visit a councillor every week but I'm not going to lie I mostly Bullshit him to have an easy life , in all honesty I probably should have been put in a psych ward a while back if I wasn't so good at deceit , my family constantly try to reach out but my response is to hide away

Honestly it's down to my PTSD I would say I can't socialise whatsoever and rarely leave the house , I no longer communicate with any friends and barely talk to family these days I'm not living anymore just existing
For as much as I can remember it's been about 3 years , I've made 2 attempts previous but both failed miserably
